_about: Empire (style id premium-iman; the Iman Gadzhi shorts look), Phantasic Premium, BETA. Since 19 Oct 2026 (owner, 10 Oct: "just have the same background and then maybe add some of the lights on the side, but not totally add the fake background lights"): the speaker's REAL room stays; no stage, no plate, no drawn neon set, no props. The side light is the depth relight (`relight` look empire: red from the left, blue from the right, falling off with depth, the far room a little darker), under a neutral contrast grade (Ahmed's Empire v1.6-v1.9: the empire-noir preset turned skin magenta and the type is graded with the footage). ONE glowing heavy ALL-CAPS phrase at a time, typed on, hung BEHIND the head: the cut-out (`matte`) is only an invisible occluder over the real footage (captions.behind without a stage, references/reel-json.md), one line first, the head covering the lower part of the line (overlap 0.8); a tight close-up with no room above the crown gets the card in front instead. Calm lines white, verdict lines red, bigger, slammed in with a shake and a low hit. Key nouns become glowing cut-out objects. Punch-ins alternate 1.0 / 1.12 with eased motion blur. The talk ends on a riser, 3 frames of silence and a boom, then the music bed's own drop takes over: a beat-locked cut ladder (2, 1, then half beats) of cinematic stills and the speaker's own shots with white flash cuts. Ends on a black caps CTA card with a green arrow and a fade to black. Engine: premium kit + captions.style 'type', endcard variant 'caps', drop.bpm/beats, music.alignDrop/dropLift (references/reel-json.md, Premium line). Port notes: music.optional and sound.completeMix are set HERE (engine defaults stay required / off), so Podcast Glow and every other style are unchanged; head-bang is not shipped, so the bed is skipped with a warning. The neon-set look (stage) is gone from the style; a reel can still set `stage` itself.

director.style: Empire: the Iman Gadzhi shorts look. Dark, expensive, confident. One glowing caps phrase at a time, typed on; the verdict phrase red and bigger. Talk for 15-22 s, then the music drop takes over.
director.captions: captions.reds: 2-4 verdict words per reel (the payoff noun or the pain word: STRONG, FUTURE, DYING). Never filler.
director.objects: 1-2 popcard beats per reel: an object PNG (obj-*.png) on the noun as spoken, label = the spoken words (2-3 words), 1.2-1.8 s. Objects only, never people.
director.drop: drop.hold = the last take; hold = 0.1 + ladder + end card (~8.2 s). bpm 136 beats [2,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,1,0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5]. Shots alternate cinematic stills (night city, highway, road, earth, mountains) and the speaker's own best moments.
director.end: endcard variant caps, 1.6-1.9 s, FOLLOW FOR MORE with FOLLOW in green, fade 0.8 s.
director.dont: No creator names, logos or org names on screen; no religion/politics; no foreign text.
